def move_one_ball(arr):
    """Determine if array can be sorted in non-decreasing order by right shifts."""
    n = len(arr)
    if n <= 1:
        return True
    # Count "breaks" where the sequence decreases (including circular boundary)
    breaks = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if arr[i] > arr[i + 1]:
            breaks += 1
    # Circular check: compare last to first
    if arr[-1] > arr[0]:
        breaks += 1
    return breaks <= 1
